name: Burning Academia
source:
You never thought you'd go to college, due to your circumstances. But you especially didn't dream you'd be forced to attend the prestigious Vales Grove University after being attacked by wraiths in their library. What started as a visit to a long time friend, ended with your hands burned, your innocence questioned, and the startling realization magic is real.

To apologize for what's happened to you, or more accurately, to keep an eye on you, the Headmaster himself offers you enrollment with all fees waived. With no real choice in the matter, you become a student, and try to ignore the suspicion everyone throws your way. Besides, you have worse things to deal with.

 Like how you've started to attract ghosts and other dead things, or the fact that there is a very living thing inside your head, waiting for you to lower guard and take control. And most pressing of all, managing your obligation to a family that hasn't been such a thing in years. Tread carefully, if the ghosts don't devour you, the university certainly might.

[From [url=https://heartsyncproductions.itch.io/burning-academia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以你的处境，你从没想过自己能上大学。更没想到的是，你会先在名校谷林大学的图书馆遭到怨灵袭击，然后被迫入学。本来只是探望一个相识已久的朋友，结果双手遭到灼伤，有人怀疑你是否清白，而你还震惊地发现，魔法竟然真的存在。

为了向你遭受的这一切致歉，或者说得更准确些，为了把你放在眼皮底下，校长亲自提出让你入学，一切费用全免。你没有什么选择的余地，只能当起学生，尽力无视众人投来的怀疑目光。何况，还有更糟的事等着你。

比如，你开始招来鬼魂和其他死物。又比如，脑袋里住进了一个活得不能再活的东西，只等你放松警惕就要接管你的身体。而最迫在眉睫的，还是你对那个家负有的责任，尽管那里已经好多年都不像个家了。步步留心吧，就算鬼魂不把你吞掉，这所大学也很可能会。
